sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

Lornoxicam is not marketed in the United States, but is available in other countries. No information is available on the clinical use of lornoxicam during breastfeeding. An alternate drug may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant.
